caption: The drawing depicts a single bucket with a cylindrical body that slightly tapers towards the base. The bucket is depicted in shades of brown and gray, giving it a worn, leather-like appearance. It has two looped handles attached to opposite sides near the rim, each handle secured by a ring, and one handle is shown arched upwards while the other rests against the rim. The bottom of the bucket features a subtle horizontal band or seam, indicating construction detail. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or design elements, and the artist's name, "Alexander Anderson," is visible in small letters at the lower right corner.
title: Leather Water Bucket
